item.title: “They are helpless too…”: Sonu Sood calls it ‘unfair’ to hold ground staff responsible amid IndiGo flight delays
item.description: MUMBAI: Actor Sonu Sood has urged passengers to remain “calm” and stop “targeting” airline ground staff after a series of IndiGo flight delays and cancellations triggered chaos across several airports in India. item.title: Kashmir Shivers as Temperature Plunges; Shopian Freezes at Minus 6.4°C
item.description: SRINAGAR: Kashmir witnessed another harsh spell of cold on Saturday, with minimum temperatures dropping further across the Valley. As per the latest meteorological data, Shopian remained the coldest spot, recording a biting low of –6.4°C. Pulwama and Pampore followed closely, each touching –5.2°C, while Baramulla dipped to –5.1°C and Anantnag to –4.9°C. Srinagar Airport recorded [...]

item.title: IndiGo Disruptions Enter Day Five; Over 1,000 Flights Cancelled Friday, Petition Filed in Supreme Court
item.description: NEW DELHI: Flight cancellations triggered by IndiGo’s operational crisis stretched into the fifth consecutive day on Saturday, with several routes across the country still affected. item.description: MUMBAI: Domestic carrier IndiGo has cancelled over 200 flights from Delhi and Mumbai on Saturday, a day after managing to temporarily secure major relaxations in the second phase of the court-mandated new flight duty and rest period norms for cockpit crew, sources said. item.description: JAMMU/SRINAGAR: IndiGo on Saturday announced the resumption of nine of its 11 flights from the Jammu Airport, but cancelled seven flights from Srinagar, owing to the nationwide disruptions caused by the airline’s pilot-rostering issues. item.title: IndiGo Restores Most Jammu Flights, But Srinagar Operations Hit as Pilot-Rostering Crisis Persists
item.description: JAMMU/SRINAGAR: IndiGo on Saturday resumed nine of its 11 scheduled flights from Jammu Airport, bringing much-needed relief to passengers stranded over the past two days due to large-scale cancellations across the country.
